name: Financial Institution Identification 4 Choice
definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a financial institution, as assigned under an internationally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.

BIC.name: BIC
BIC.definition: Code allocated to a financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

NameAndAddress.name: Name And Address
NameAndAddress.definition: Name and address of an institution.
